Kidd Roofing handles roof work for both residential and commercial sectors in Texas with offices in Austin, San Antonio, Dallas and Houston. We also have an office in Denver, CO and Orlando, FL

The roof over our heads protects us from the elements, keeps us safe, and turns a house into a home. That’s a pretty big job. Unfortunately, most of us don’t realize how much we depend on our roof until there is a major problem. Whether a hailstorm has left its mark on your roof, you have a leak or need shingles replaced, or you need extensive repairs or re-roofing, the professionals at Kidd Roofing have you covered, literally.

We have made it our mission to help a wide variety of clients, including homeowners, home builders, property managers, and contractors, get the quality roofing they deserve. If you are looking for a team of experienced roofers dedicated to getting your job done right the first time, look no further than Kidd Roofing. Contact us today at 866-671-7791 to talk with one of our roofing professionals.

After dealing with a rough experience with Ace Roofing increasing their quote by 50% for the same job, my clients (very upset at the time) and I scrambled to problem solve and luckily found Jeff and Kidd Roofing.
They got to the job fast, worked our extremely pressed timeline, and had great communication the entire time. To top it off the future buyer of the home had the new roof inspected and the inspector/other roofing company complimented the work. All parties were completely satisfied and I will be recommending and hopefully using Jeff going forward for my future clients.
5 stars well deserved.

CG
Our

Commitment to Excellence

We don’t take roofing repair lightly. A roof is an investment that protects your assets and, most importantly, your family. That’s why we are committed to paying attention to detail and ensuring that not only do you have the best quality products available but that you have an exceptional customer service experience.

We are also a company committed to safety, yours and ours. We have a full-time Safety Manager on staff who is responsible for training all of our employees and inspecting every job site. Our employees hold a wealth of skill and experience; it is important to us that we provide them with a safe and healthy working environment while ensuring that your project is up to code.

OUR BENEFITS

Why Choose Kidd Roofing

You have a lot of options when it comes to selecting a roofing company. Why choose the professionals at Kidd Roofing? The answer is simple – we have over 38 years of experience in the industry. We know our business, and we know how to treat our customers. Kidd Roofing, is not a “fly-by-night” operation with reps who come knocking on your door 20 minutes after a hailstorm hits. We were founded in 1982 and since then have flourished to become one of America’s Top 100 roofing contractors.

That’s important to us because it means our customers trust us with what matters most, protecting their home and family. Our dedicated team of professionals has hands-on experience in all types of roofing projects, which has helped us cultivate a reputation for quality and excellence within the roofing industry.

If that weren’t enough, Kidd Roofing, has an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau and is members of the National Roofing Contractors Association. We have also earned valuable certifications with all of the major roofing manufacturers, including Aluminum, Berridge, Carlisle, Centria, Certainteed, Firestone, GAF, Garland, Johns Manville, Petersen, Tamko, and more. While the accolades are nice, we never forget who it is we work for, you.

Family Owned & Operated

Common Roofing Questions

1

Can you do emergency roofing repairs?

Absolutely. If storm or hail damage has left you with an emergency roofing situation, contact us today. We are happy to provide customers with emergency roofing services. We know you can’t plan for everything and will make every attempt to get you the service and repairs you need before the damage can get any worse.

2

Are you able to help me if I have an insurance claim?

We know that dealing with an insurance company on top of having a roofing problem can be a headache. We are committed to giving you the best possible service while helping you navigate through an insurance claim. Talk to one of our professionals about your insurance options.

3

Aren’t roof projects expensive? What if I can’t afford to get a repair done?

The big question is, how can you afford not to get a roof repair done? A small issue now won’t just go away; it will eventually turn into a big and much more expensive problem down the line. If you are concerned about costs, we can help. We have roofing financing options available for remodeling and re-roofing projects. We want to help you protect your investments – let us work with you to find a payment option that works for you.
